title: Understanding fractions
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, pictures and word problems. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Fractions bigger than 1 can be written as improper fractions or mixed numbers.

items.prompt: What fraction of the bar is shaded?  {bar 3/5}
What number is at the dot?  {line 1 6 5}
What number is at the dot?  {line 2 4 7}
4 friends share 3 pizzas equally. How much pizza does each friend get?
A group has 7 students, and 2 of them wear glasses. What fraction of the group wears glasses?
What fraction of the dots are shaded?  {dots 4/9}
What number is at the dot?  {line 1 8 3}
What number is at the dot?  {line 3 3 7}
What whole number is {18/6} equal to?
3 people share 5 sandwiches equally. How much does each person get?
A pie is cut into 8 equal slices, and 3 slices have been eaten. What fraction of the pie has been eaten?
